profile.headline: Radar Software Engineer at Raytheon Technologies
profile.summary: I have worked some time in Unity game development, and I also have been learning graphics programming using OpenGL, as well as Vulkan more recently. The world of graphics programming runs incredibly deep, and I still have a lot left to learn, but I LOVE learning, and what better way to learn than to make a career of it!

positions.title: Radar Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Researched, analyzed, and resolved bugs daily in MATLAB and C++ code, improving the performance and quality of the regression suite
• Fixed over half of existing test failures and errors of a project, increasing the team’s capability to analyze relevant systems, and improving the regression suite’s success rate for this project by ~70%
• Coordinated with team members and other developers daily to overcome problems and resolve tickets
positions.insights: Software Development, Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and +3 skills

positions.title: Professional development
positions.description: I took this time to engross myself in learning C++, OpenGL, and GLSL shader programming, while working a part-time job.

positions.title: Pega Systems Architect
positions.description:
• Completed a Java full stack bootcamp, concluding with a solo banking application project
• Completed a Pega system architecture bootcamp, concluding with a loan disbursement management system team project
• Obtained a contract with Cognizant as a Pega System Architect for 5 months

positions.title: Lead VR Developer
positions.locationName: Greenville, North Carolina, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Started development on a virtual reality application for testing and analyzing real workers’ responses to different workplace accidents based on various factors, such as the ethnicity and gender of the person in the accident
• Developed for the Oculus Quest using the Unity game engine
• Utilized Blender to rig and animate 3D-scanned models for use in the game
• Created multiple construction accident environments in-engine using various assets to narrow down a style

projects.title: Real-Time Physically Based Renderer
projects.description:
• Implemented physically based rendering using OpenGL and GLSL in a C++ driven Windows application
• Utilized the ImGUI library to enable modification of object properties and scene settings during runtime

projects.title: Voxel Terrain Generator
projects.description:
• Implemented a multithreaded, Minecraft-inspired terrain generator using OpenGL and GLSL in a C++ driven Windows application
• Utilized the FastNoiseLite library to generate OpenSimplex2 noise, which was used as a height map for the terrain
